The '''Card-flux Pulse Emitter''' was installed in the [[RH7 CardShark]] [[Dealer droid/Legends|dealer droid]]. During a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]], it would emit random electronic pulses. The cards would be affected by the pulse, fluctuating in value unless they were placed in the [[interference field]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
